title: Orders
description: Manage service orders between customers and providers.

help.title: About Orders
help.overview: A marketplace order is a service engagement between a customer and a provider. It can start from an active listing (with optional package and add-ons) or from an accepted bid on a task request. Work, delivery, revisions, milestones, and escrow release move through dedicated actions — not by editing status on the form.

sections.title: Statuses
items: Pending — created; waiting for the provider to accept.
Accepted — provider accepted; work has not started yet.
Completed — work finished and remaining escrow released as rules allow.
Cancelled — stopped before completion; escrow handling follows cancel rules.

sections.title: Typical lifecycle
items: Create from listing builds amount from listing, package, and add-ons; providers cannot order their own listing.
Accept / start / cancel advance or stop the engagement.
Deliveries and revision requests sit on related records tied to the order.
Milestones can hold and release escrow; completing the last pending milestone can complete the order.
An open dispute blocks some money movements until it is resolved or closed.
sections.body: Actions enforce who may move the order and from which status.

sections.title: Related records
items: Bookings schedule time against an order.
Disputes open when a party contests the engagement.
Reviews are left against a completed order and its listing.
Soft delete hides the order from default lists; it can be restored.
